desc: Faculty of Biomedical Engineering produces only ~25% of its normal research output.
Faculty of IT is a top contributor to research outputs (2x normal).
Faculty of EEE records zero international publications in June-July.
Faculty of Biotechnology has a spike of co-authored papers in August.
Professor/Associate Professor ratio at Faculty of BME is 12 points below IU average.
Share of PhD faculty at Faculty of Foreign Languages is 15 points below IU average.
One lecturer in each of these units has almost no research output.
An Giang University completes only ~45% of what its peers do on cumulative KPIs.
University of Science over-performs (~140%) on cumulative KPIs.
